# Telangana RTA Learner's Licence Practice (STALL Simulator)
> Authoritative public preparation resource for the Telangana RTA Learner's Licence computerized STALL (Screen Test Aid for Learner Licence) examination conducted across Hyderabad and all Telangana District RTOs.

- Website: https://llr.sarvacapital.in/
- Hosted by: Sarva Capital (https://sarvacapital.in)
- Access: 100% Free, No Login Required, Works Offline (PWA)
- Languages: Trilingual support in English, Telugu (తెలుగు), and Hindi (हिन्दी)
- Master Question Bank: 412 authentic questions from Telangana Transport Department (94 Road Signs, 159 Rules of the Road, 159 General Driving Principles)

## Key Examination Facts (Telangana STALL)
- **Exam Name**: STALL (Screen Test Aid for Learner Licence) computerized examination.
- **Governing Body**: Transport Department, Government of Telangana (Telangana RTA) under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 & Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989.
- **Total Questions per Exam**: 20 questions randomly sampled across 3 mandatory quotas:
  - 8 Mandatory / Cautionary / Informatory Road Signs (40%)
  - 8 Rules of the Road Regulations (40%)
  - 4 General Driving Principles & Vehicle Safety (20%)
- **Time Limit**: 30 seconds per question (maximum 10 minutes total).
- **Passing Mark**: 12 correct out of 20 (60% minimum).
- **Negative Marking**: None.
- **Early Termination Rule**: In the official STALL exam terminal, as soon as a candidate reaches 12 correct answers, the test immediately concludes and declares the candidate as "PASSED". If a candidate accumulates 9 wrong answers (making 12 correct mathematically impossible), the test terminates with "FAILED".
- **Hardware/Interface**: Exam terminals use touchscreens and 4-key numeric hardware strips (1, 2, 3, 4). Options remain in fixed 1-4 order matching the official master question bank.

## Practice Features Available on llr.sarvacapital.in
1. **STALL Mock Test**: Exact simulation of the Telangana RTO computer screen with 20 questions, 30s timer, pass counter, and real-exam mode or tutor mode with audio read-aloud.
2. **Topic Practice**: Filter by Road Signs (94 questions), Rules of the Road (159 questions), or General Principles (159 questions).
3. **Interactive Flashcards**: 94 road sign flashcards with instant flip explanations.
4. **Tricky Twins**: Side-by-side comparative analysis of easily confused signs (e.g., Mandatory Speed Limit vs Minimum Speed, No Entry vs One Way, Side Road Left vs Turn Left).
5. **Rapid Cheatsheet**: Numerical limits, speed limits, alcohol limits (30mg/100ml BAC), penalty fines, and must-know legal rules.
6. **Hyderabad RTO Guide**: Exact step-by-step test-day walkthrough for Khairatabad (TS-09), Secunderabad (TS-10), Kondapur/Rangareddy (TS-07), Uppal (TS-08), Mehdipatnam, and Medchal RTOs.
7. **95% Readiness Gate**: Algorithm tracking 2 consecutive clean answers per question (spaced mastery) to guarantee test-day success.
8. **Cross-Device Sync**: Transfer progress between phone and desktop via encrypted single-string code.

## Official Telangana RTO Test Centers Covered
- RTO Central (Khairatabad) - TS-09
- RTO North (Secunderabad / Trimulgherry) - TS-10
- RTO West (Tolichowki / Mehdipatnam) - TS-11
- RTO East (Malakpet) - TS-12
- RTO South (Chandrayangutta / Kishanbagh) - TS-13
- RTO Rangareddy / Cyberabad (Kondapur) - TS-07
- RTO Uppal - TS-08
- RTO Medchal / Malkajgiri - TS-08
- All District Transport Offices (Warangal, Karimnagar, Nizamabad, Khammam, Mahbubnagar, Nalgonda, etc.)
